```{python}
#| label: fig-czochralski
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Czochralski crystal growth: a rotating seed crystal is slowly pulled out of the silicon melt, growing a large single-crystal ingot."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Polygon, Circle

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 5))

# crucible with melt
ax.add_patch(Polygon([(1, 0.4), (1, 2.6), (1.4, 2.6), (1.4, 0.8),
                      (6.6, 0.8), (6.6, 2.6), (7, 2.6), (7, 0.4)],
                     closed=True, fc='#888888', ec='k', lw=1))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.4, 0.8), 5.2, 1.6, fc='#f4a940', ec='none'))
ax.text(4, 1.4, 'Si melt (1420 °C)', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.text(6.9, 3.0, 'crucible', fontsize=9)

# ingot
ax.add_patch(Polygon([(3.4, 2.4), (3.3, 3.0), (3.5, 4.2), (3.7, 5.2),
                      (4.3, 5.2), (4.5, 4.2), (4.7, 3.0), (4.6, 2.4)],
                     closed=True, fc='#c9c9c9', ec='k', lw=1))
ax.text(5.0, 4.0, 'single-crystal\ningot', fontsize=9)

# seed and pull rod
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((3.85, 5.2), 0.3, 0.5, fc='#c9c9c9', ec='k', lw=1))
ax.text(4.4, 5.4, 'seed', fontsize=9)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((3.95, 5.7), 0.1, 1.3, fc='k'))
ax.annotate('', xy=(4.0, 8.0), xytext=(4.0, 7.1),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', lw=1.2))
ax.text(4.25, 7.5, 'pull & rotate', fontsize=9)

# heater coils
for y in [1.0, 1.6, 2.2]:
    ax.add_patch(Circle((0.6, y), 0.15, fc='none', ec='r', lw=1.5))
    ax.add_patch(Circle((7.4, y), 0.15, fc='none', ec='r', lw=1.5))
ax.text(0.6, 3.0, 'heater', color='r', fontsize=9, ha='center')

ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 8.6)
ax.set_ylim(0, 8.4)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
